name: Whim to Rim to Rim to Rim
gear: HOKA Tecton X 3 Stormy Skies / Cerise
description: Been feeling unmotivated recently, even with endurance so this is what it took to get me excite. Never been here before! Hot but not too hot - 97 in the canyon during the afternoon. Cool Ribbon waterfall detour. Running down into a canyon is psychologically much harder than running up a mountain
